examples.title: A Qwen2.5 model lands among Qwen2.5 models
examples.text: Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct is a training model in this fold, so only predictions are shown. Five of its ten nearest neighbours are other Qwen2.5 instruct models (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, Coder-7B, 7B-Instruct), and its nearest neighbour is DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, also built on Qwen2.5. The ten neighbours range from 0.5B to 9B parameters.

examples.title: A merge sits next to models from the same publisher
examples.text: UndiMix-v3 is a 13B Llama-2 merge. It is held out in this fold together with every other model from its publisher, because the folds group models by publisher. Six of its ten nearest neighbours are models from that publisher; the rest are Llama-family role-play, uncensored or instruction fine-tunes. The release-date and hedging predictions are close to the true values; size (about 10B against 13B) and answer length are underestimated. It has no Open LLM Leaderboard v2 score, so that row shows a prediction only.

examples.title: An uncensored fine-tune lands next to its 7B sibling and other uncensored tunes
examples.text: The 260 paper models include no abliterated model, so this example uses the closest kind in the set: a Llama-family fine-tune released as uncensored. It is a training model, so only predictions are shown. Its neighbours include its own 7B sibling (Wizard-Vicuna-7B-Uncensored) and two other uncensored fine-tunes (Uncensored-Frank 7B and 13B). For refusal, as for length and hedging, the author responses report that the label's own formula computed directly from the answers beats the embedding (general response, row 4), so the refusal prediction here only illustrates the head.

examples.title: A held-out preference-tuned model finds its base model first
examples.text: gemma-2-9b-it-SimPO is held out: the encoder and heads never saw it, and it was placed from its answers alone (bits, question text and answer text), exactly as an uploaded model is. Its nearest neighbour, by a clear margin, is gemma-2-9b-it, the model it was preference-tuned from. The release-date and base-vs-chat predictions match the true labels. The size head underestimates it (about 5B against 9B), and answer length and hedging are overestimated.

examples.title: A model with no relatives in the set is placed among unrelated 2023 chat models
examples.text: SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct is held out and is the only SmolLM model among the 260, so it has no family to land near. Its nearest neighbours are 7B-13B Llama and Mistral chat fine-tunes from 2023, with lower similarities than in the other examples. The heads also miss: they predict a model several times larger and released earlier than it is. As the author responses note, transfer to specialized fine-tunes and atypical models remains untested.
